book.name: 2 Qorontoose
book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoose Asas Xaafida Nam7antho Kiita

content: Mernas daanaso
Nuni izan biitta bolla diza dunkaney laalettikkokka asa kushen gidonta Xoossa kushen oosettida merna keeththi nuus salon dizayssa nu eroos.
He wodey gakkanaas nu keeththa saloyssa may7anas nu laamoti naagos.
Tumappe hessa nu may7idappe guye kallottokko.

Nuni hayssa ha dunkanezan diza wode ubban izi deexxiza gish daabura piidhi goos. Hessas gaasoyka hayqqizayssi de7on laamettana mala nuni salon daana soza may7ana attin nuuppe qaarettana mala nu koyokko.
Hessas nuna giigissiday Xoossa. Buro yaanayssas waase gidana mala nuus ba Ayana immiday iza.
Nuni ashon diza wode Godappe haakki dizayssa erikkoka izan ammanettidi doos.
Nuni diza duussay Godan ammanidi attin ayfen be7on gidenna.
Nuni ashoppe shaaketidi Godara duus dooranayssa ta sidhonta yootays.
Hessa gish nu ashon diikko woykko ashoppe shaaketikkokka nuus waanna qofay Goda ufayso.
Nuni wurikka Kirstoosa pirda wombora sinthi shiiqanayssi attenna; nuuppe issoy issoy biitta bolla ba ooththida iita gidin woykko lo7o gidin ba ooso mala bessiza waaga ekkana.
Asa Xoossara maqaynitho ooso

Hessa gish Godas babo guussi ay guussakkonne nu eriza gish asay nu yootizayssa ero gi ekkana mala ooththanas daaburoos. Nuni oonantakkonne Xoossa achchan qonce. Qasseka inte woznanka qonce gididayssa ta ammanays.
Ta hessa gizay nuna inte sinthan galatanas gidonta dishin inte nunan ceeqqettana mala attin woznappe gidonta ayfen beettiza miishan ceeqqettizaytas inte zaaro immanas dandayana mala gaada gays.
Nu goosh gidikko Xoossa gish giidi gooyidos. Erata gidikkoka intes giidikko!
Kirstoosi ubbas issito hayqqoyssanne haray wurikka izara issife hayqqidayssa nu erida gish Kirstoosa siiqoy nuna wolqara oosises.
Shempora paxa dizayti wurikka he hayqqidayssassinne hayqoppe dendidayssas daana malappe attin hayssafe guye isti baasi doonta mala Kirstoosi ubbas hayqqides.
Hessa gish hayssafe guye nuni oona assikka asho ayfen xeellokko. Nuni hayssafe kase Kirstoosa asho ayfen xeelliday coo mela asa mala xeello, gidikkoka hayssafe guye sinthas gidikko hessatho xeello.
Hessa gish oonikka Kirstoosa bagga gidikko izi ooratha medhetetha. Kase ceega medhetethay aadhdhides. He iza kichchosan hara ooratha medhetethi gelides.
Hessi wuri haniday izi nuna banara Kirstoosa baggara maqaynthidinne maqayntho ooso nuus immida Xoossana.
Hessika Xoossi Kirstoosa baggara hanko alame asa wursikka banara maqayinthides guussa. Isti qohozakka qoodibenna. Nuuska nu asa Godara maqayinthana qaala immides.
Xoossi nu baggara as xeygiza gish nuni qasse Kirstoosa ogathata. Hessa gish “Inte Xoossara maqaynite!” giidi nu intena Kirstoosa sunthan woossos.
Nuni Kirstoosa baggara Xoossa xilloteth gishetti ekkizayta gidana mala Xoossi iza bolla nagaray baynda Kirstoosi izi nu nagara tookkana mala ooththides.
